narrative.overview:
The site is a screen-printed event poster that moves. A signal yellow field with a faint white grid fills the first screen. Strips cross the field and repeat the SANDBOX wordmark. The wordmark is seven sealed boxes; a carve opens each box into a letter.

The page uses three inks: yellow, warm ink, and paper. The type is one variable family that changes width instead of changing font. The surface is flat, with square corners and 2px rules. Motion tells the product story: a sealed box opens, and the visitor enters it.

The world replaces the earlier near-black Carbon canvas. The world also rejects the sticker-and-shadow look of the v2 site. The result must not look too playful, and must not look like a corporate SaaS page.
keyCharacteristics: A signal yellow field with a white grid.
Three inks only: yellow, warm ink, and paper.
Strips that alternate polarity, with end caps and a fringe.
A custom SANDBOX wordmark made of seven carved boxes.
Archivo Variable at width 125 and weight 900 for display type.
Square corners, 2px rules, and no cast shadows.
Six named motions: carve, wipe, stretch, shear, rule-draw, and breach.

rules.name: The Yellow Field Rule
rules.body: Yellow is the brand colour and the user fixed it. Yellow stays the page field on every new surface.

rules.name: The Three Inks Rule
rules.body: Every surface is yellow, ink, or paper. The secondary text tones tint these inks. The system has no second accent.

rules.name: The White Is Not Text Rule
rules.body: White and paper never carry text on yellow. White appears on yellow only as grid lines and strip fills.

rules.name: The Width Is Voice Rule
rules.body: Hierarchy comes from width and weight inside one family. Display type uses width 125. Width 62 appears only in the Loop words at rest.

rules.name: The Codes Only Rule
rules.body: Martian Mono sets machine values only: Z codes, phase numbers, the version tag, and coordinates. Martian Mono never sets a heading, a label, or a sentence.

rules.name: The Group Label Rule
rules.body: A label names a group of items. A label never sits above a title as a kicker.

rules.name: The Flat Print Rule
rules.body: Nothing casts a shadow and nothing blends. A gradient is legal only as a hard-edged line pattern, such as the grid and the fringe.

rules.name: The Square Corner Rule
rules.body: Buttons, tiles, panels, tags, and strips never round a corner. Curves belong to the carves and to the registration mark.

dos: Do keep the page field yellow (`{colors.yellow}`) on every new surface.
Do build each surface from the three inks: yellow, ink, and paper.
Do set every box with square corners and 2px solid rules.
Do set display type in Archivo at weight 900, width 125, and uppercase.
Do set Z codes, phase numbers, the version tag, and coordinates in Martian Mono.
Do alternate strip polarity when strips stack.
Do separate list items with 2px rules.
Do reveal content with one named motion from section 10.
Do use the CSS custom properties; keep hex values out of component rules.
Do mark unknown facts as "To be announced".
donts: Don't add a second accent colour.
Don't set text in white or paper on yellow.
Don't set body text in yellow.
Don't round a corner on a button, a tile, a panel, a tag, or a strip.
Don't add a cast shadow, a glow, a blur, or a blended gradient.
Don't add a third font family. The SVG wordmark is art, so it does not count.
Don't set a heading or a sentence in Martian Mono.
Don't place a small label above a title as a kicker.
Don't fade a section up on scroll.
Don't add an illustration or a stock photo. Repetition of the wordmark is the graphic.
Don't bring back the near-black Carbon canvas, IBM Plex, or the v2 sticker-and-shadow look.
